summary: Local dashboard performance: scoped reads, request-owned streamed SSR batches, optional delivery and idle query activation.
noAssistantImpact: No assistant capability, tool, procedure, permission, entitlement, confirmation, schema or provider action changes. Assistant UI lifecycle pauses optional idle reads while hidden, keeps drafts mounted, prevents hidden auto-start and preserves pending-command finalization/durable run recovery. Existing fresh server checks, scope reset and command owners remain. Other changes are internal tracing/read scheduling/code delivery. No deployment. Dashboard shell now reads current plan features through one joined projection rather than the full plan catalogue; canonical feature resolution/fallback is preserved. Full billing/entitlement readers and command admission are unchanged. Server reads now stream within one render-owned batch; API authentication/scope, browser mutation/body transport, deadlines and full command authority remain. Default-off diagnostics follow JSONL/SSE body lifetime, preserving bytes, cancellation and refusals without retaining content. Nine presentation routes now return their existing loading owners while prefetch remains pending; session/role/permitted-Store/pharmacy admission remains before reads. Setup and clinical workspace-access dependency waits remain. Customer channels now isolates optional read status/retries; current workspace refusal still removes admitted content, manager sections mount only with canManage, and existing API/procedure/command/sheet/invalidation authority is unchanged.

docs.note: Tracing/read scheduling only; no schema or migration.

evidence.result: Actual protected procedure callers reduced repeated read facts from3 to1 per GET. POST/mutations/new requests/readers/database identities/strict-vs-recovery/QA scope remain isolated; each procedure owns its facts.
Fixed phase/count Server-Timing excludes arbitrary labels, values and nonfinite metrics; concurrent request/SQL/pool isolation and exporter-failure behavior pass.
Server-minted request correlation remains opaque; arbitrary inbound private identifiers are refused.
All27 original requirements preserved with separate per-family source/runtime and latency acceptance; no rollout.

Catalog/Finance heavy bodies deferred behind existing open conditions. Dashboard types, optimized build and owned fast220/1481 pass. Existing-data Catalog open/close/focus/Back and Finance deep-link/cancel pass; no business submission. Other sheet families and optimized-runtime timings remain open.

Actual Finance/Services route tests reproduced6 scheduling failures before repair;11 tests/20 assertions now pass with real QueryClient. Finance starts book alongside pending display reads; Services only prefetches the selected authorized tab and open-sheet dependencies. Signed-out/role/Store admission and filter/cursor bounds remain.

Measured dev delivery removes payment-review and Setup chat/draft bodies from closed Overview. Banking formatter and Setup controllers unchanged. Types,28/86 focused,220/1481 fast and notification UI pass; new optimized/open-Setup proof remains pending. No authority or provider change.

Real mounted GeneralChat/hook/composer and QueryClient observers reproduced hidden reads/auto-start before correction. Five cases/28 assertions now pass: idle zero new reads after hide/invalidation/poll ticks, draft/attachment/recorder retention, late-history guard, pending command finalization and streamed-run recovery. Existing attachment-switch regression,237/1531 fast source, types and actual saved-chat draft/minimize/reopen pass; no business submission.

Actual shell regression reproduced3 repository reads before repair, now1. Free navigation, optional-failure fallback and admission-before-plan remain. Canonical billing parity tests cover27 policy cases, current rereads, isolated returned arrays and error propagation; one existing-data read-only comparison confirms3 SQL queries versus1 with identical features.

Actual server client/Hono/tRPC/protected middleware tests reproduce blocked ready results and cross-owner module-global batching under an isolated RSC host cache adapter. Six cases/40 assertions pass: per-owner batches, one shared eligibility/Tenant read per batch, pending hydration without duplicate fetch, fresh refusal clearing old data, typed date results and opted-in cancellation.

Response setup no longer masquerades as full streaming completion. Header/cookie/status preservation, Hono header merge, default-off behavior, no-buffer first chunk, final query work, error/cancellation, exporter failure and frozen terminal snapshots pass with fixed numeric diagnostics only.

Actual nine route functions with real QueryClient prefetch reproduce9 blocked loading owners, now22 tests/64 assertions pass. Signed-out/manager/pharmacy admission, selected permitted Store, operator-only reads and open booking dependencies remain. This tests route scheduling, not rendered browser latency.

Mounted real useQuery observers reproduce10 failure cases before correction.16 tests/109 assertions pass: four independent pending/error/retry owners, fresh errors hiding retained payloads, no manager reads/rendering after denied access, workspace refusal and Store boundary, unchanged approval amount/decision/review URL. Inert transport/presentation, no external fixtures or commands.
